title: Visit us
desc: Location, transit information, and operating hours, for our East 30th Street building.

blocks.html:
Business Hours: Mon-Fri, 10am - 6pm
Gallery/Exhibition Hours: Mon-Fri, 2 - 6pm (by appointment)

***We are open on weekends from 10am-6pm for workshops and tintype appointments.


To schedule a visit, please email us: info@penumbrafoundation.org

M1, M2, M3, M4, M5 at 30th Street and 5th Avenue (South)

M1, M2, M3 at 30th Street and Madison Avenue (North)

N, R, Q, F.M, D, B at 34 Street and Avenue of the Americas

4, 6 at 28th Street and Park Avenue
